RunDBCommand.title: Execute a database command
RunDBCommand.extraInfo:
This API is relatively complex. The following examples illustrate some usage methods for your reference:

### Retrieve a collection list  
Input parameters (params):  
```
{
    "SpaceId": "mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****",
    "Body": "{"command":"collections"}"
}
```  
Result (data):  
```
{
	"AffectedDocs":5,
	"RequestId":"4CFE11BE-536C-58DD-****",
	"Success":true,
	"Result":"["album","photo","test","users","wallpaper"]"
}
```

### Create a collection  
Input parameters (params):  
```
{
    "SpaceId": "mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****",
    "Body": "{"command":"createCollection", "name":"mytable"}"
}
```  
Result (data):  
```
{
	"AffectedDocs":1,
	"RequestId":"042ED29A-3148-5133-ABEA-****",
	"Success":true,
	"Result":"["mytable"]"
}
```

### Create an index  

Create a non-unique compound index on the collection "mytable", sorted by userId in ascending order and userName in descending order.

Input parameters (params):  
```
{
    "SpaceId": "mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****",
    "Body": "{"command":"createIndex", "collection":"mytable", "field":{"userId":1,"userName":-1}, "options":{"name":"idx-userid-username", "unique":false} }"
}
```  
Result (data):  
```
{
	"AffectedDocs":0,
	"RequestId":"C67E7C63-EB30-506E-BF28-****",
	"Success":true,
	"Result":"idx-userid-username"
}
```

### Retrieve an index list  
Input parameters (params):  
```
{
    "SpaceId": "mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****",
    "Body": "{"command":"listIndexes", "collection":"mytable"}"
}
```  
Result (data):  
```
{
    "AffectedDocs": 2,
    "RequestId": "8B8F315A-FBCA-560E-8C85-****",
    "Success": true,
    "Result": "[{"v":2,"key":{"_id":1},"name":"_id_","ns":"db_ALYEZT****_mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****.mytable"},{"v":2,"key":{"userId":1,"userName":-1},"name":"idx-userid-username","ns":"db_ALYEZT****_mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****.mytable"}]"
}
```

### Delete an index  
Input parameters (params):  
```
{
    "SpaceId": "mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****",
    "Body": "{"command":"dropIndex", "collection":"mytable", "indexName":"idx-userid-username"}"
}
```  
Result (data):  
```
{
    "AffectedDocs": 0,
    "RequestId": "1EE343F7-9DE8-534C-AE12-****",
    "Success": true
}
```

### Insert a document  
Input parameters (params):  
```
{
    "SpaceId": "mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****",
    "Body": "{"command":"insertOne", "collection":"mytable", "doc":{"userId":1, "userName":"张三"}}"
}
```  
Result (data):  
```
{
    "AffectedDocs": 1,
    "RequestId": "B1032DBA-51CF-5E47-91C5-****",
    "Success": true,
    "Result": "{"insertedId":"636496e2f43e60aba4939f5f","ok":1,"n":1}"
}
```

### Query the first ten documents  
Input parameters (params):  
```
{
    "SpaceId": "mp-c68e6766-2bda-4263-916d-****",
    "Body": "{"command":"find", "collection":"mytable", "query":{}, "options":{"skip":0, "limit":10}}"
}
```  
Result (data):  
```
{
    "AffectedDocs": 2,
    "RequestId": "AB1F4B1C-F6E6-5E49-AB4B-****",
    "Success": true,
    "Result": "[{"_id":"636496e2f43e60aba4939f5f","userName":"张三","userId":1},{"_id":"636496ef819ce88b66f34b6d","userName":"李四","userId":2}]"
}
```

schema.description:
Specifies whether to enable the cross-domain feature. Valid values:
- true: Enables the cross-domain feature.
- false: Disables the cross-domain feature.

Specifies the cross-origin validation rule. The default value is "*". The cross-origin validation rules are as follows:
- If set to "*", the system returns "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *" regardless of whether the user's request includes an "Origin" parameter or what value the "Origin" parameter carries.
- If one or more specific values are configured for the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header (multiple values separated by commas):
    - If the "Origin" value in the request header exactly matches any of the configured values, the corresponding cross-origin header is returned.
    - If no exact match is found, no cross-origin header is returned.
- If a wildcard domain name is configured, the system validates whether the Origin value in the request header matches the wildcard pattern.

When cross-origin verification is enabled, specifies whether to validate the Origin field.
- true: Returns cross-origin headers only after validation succeeds.
- false: Does not validate the Origin field and always returns the configured cross-origin headers.

This parameter is optional and defaults to true. It takes effect only when the cross-domain feature is enabled.
